title: SIMD-0553 Tower-Defense Feasibility Probe
researchBoundary: Internal research only. Observed devnet transaction data is separated from derived calculations and counterfactual fees. No causal or policy conclusion is asserted.

programAttribution.historyMethod: Most-recent consecutive devnet getSignaturesForAddress rows, locally retained only after an outer instruction matched the supplied program ID.
programAttribution.assessment: Clean enough for a bounded devnet economics probe. This proves outer-program attribution, not application semantics beyond program/log evidence.

terms.signatureCost: 720 units × transaction signature count; precompile signature costs are not separately decoded in this probe.
terms.programsExecutionCost: Compute Budget requested CU limit. A missing explicit limit is UNKNOWN in this probe rather than assumed.
terms.loadedAccountsDataSizeCost: ceil(requested loaded-account bytes / 32768) × 8; default 67108864 bytes when no SetLoadedAccountsDataSizeLimit instruction is present.

formula.rpcCostUnitsCaveat: meta.costUnits is retained as OBSERVED but not substituted for requested_cost_units: the first probe receipt reported 268,023 meta.costUnits alongside an observed 1,400,000 CU limit. The counterfactual follows SIMD-0553’s specified requested terms instead.
formula.blockFullness: SIMD-0553 resource_fee is defined from a transaction’s requested_cost_units and the active rate. The formula has no block-utilization input. Low block utilization is therefore a separate policy/economic question, not a fee-calculation modifier in this draft.
formula.failureTreatment: The draft says fee-only transactions continue to debit full total_fee, now including resource_fee. This probe does not assume all failed execution paths are fee-only; each landed failure retains its observed current fee and the same formula is shown as a counterfactual when requested terms are available.
